decisions.reason: The material-finish and gold-distribution exploration does not alter the geometric peak-alignment rule between the Hero V and É accent.
Applying champagne gold to selected elements does not change the shared terminal geometry, derivation, or locked revision policy.
The source explores color distribution on the second V right arm but does not change the second V's geometry, construction method, or optical relationship to the Hero V.
The source preserves the locked Hero V geometry and varies only its material finish and color application.
Rendering the non-signature letters in black under the proposed options does not modify their architectural form, originality, proportions, or relationship to the Hero V.
The optional champagne-gold application to the É accent does not change its required literal vector derivation from the Hero V terminal.
The material-distribution comparison does not change the second V's established size, height, or compositional hierarchy.
The source requests finish and color-distribution comparisons without changing kerning, spacing, or wordmark rhythm.
The selective gold treatment does not alter the E and L cap-height alignment with the second V's left arm.
The source changes only material finish and distribution options; the common baseline remains valid unchanged.
The material comparison request neither changes nor removes the obligation to explain design intentions and their translation into rendered work.
